description: 12-check release readiness gate for autodev-ai. Run via: python scripts/release_readiness_gate.py

checks.name: package_metadata_valid
checks.description: tomllib reads pyproject.toml; validates name, version, requires-python, autodev entry-point referencing autodev.cli:app

checks.name: cli_help_works
checks.description: subprocess call `autodev --help` (or python -m autodev.cli --help) exits 0; skip if not on PATH

checks.name: pytest_evidence
checks.description: Runs smoke subset pytest tests/unit/test_prfaq_style.py or detects .dev-factory/ test records

checks.name: ruff_passes
checks.description: `ruff check .` exits 0; skip if ruff not on PATH
checks.baseline_detail: ruff not on PATH in venv activation context

checks.name: mypy_passes
checks.description: `mypy src/autodev` exits 0; skip if mypy not on PATH
checks.baseline_detail: pydantic_ai_bridge.py:137 — Agent overload mismatch (pre-existing, not introduced by this gate)

checks.name: docs_exist
checks.description: README.md present + at least 5 of: docs/quickstart.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/faq.md, docs/tutorials/, examples/README.md

checks.name: mcp_smoke_path_exists
checks.description: tests/integration/test_mcp_server_smoke.py exists OR src/autodev/mcp_server/ has a main entry

checks.name: a2a_smoke_path_exists
checks.description: tests/ containing a2a or roundtable in filename total >= 5

checks.name: mock_executor_works
checks.description: FACTORY_FORCE_MOCK=1 autodev classify-input --input test exits 0; skip if not available
checks.baseline_detail: classify-input sub-command not available; gate-level skip

checks.name: no_dangerous_release_claims
checks.description: README.md must not contain: 'available on pypi now' / 'production ready' / 'enterprise certified'

checks.name: release_blockers_recorded
checks.description: docs/validation/ has a *release_hardening_round* aggregator, release_blockers.md, or autodev_release_readiness_gate.* file

known_blockers.issue: No overload variant of Agent matches argument types — pre-existing mypy error, not introduced by this gate
known_blockers.action_required: Fix pydantic-ai Agent call signature before release
